## Airbus First Quarter (Q1) 2026 financial results

At a glance

> The Q1 results reflect the lower level of commercial aircraft deliveries and a strong performance
> in our Defence and Space division. The operating environment remains dynamic and complex. We are
> closely monitoring the potential impact from the fast-changing situation in the Middle East. In
> commercial aircraft, we continue to ramp up and produce as per our plan while navigating the
> shortage of Pratt & Whitney engines.

## This year marks Moog’s 75th anniversary, reflecting decades of resilience and ingenuity.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

# Building a future we can all trust

We support businesses, organisations, and governments in addressing tomorrow’s major challenges by
developing advanced Defence, Security, Cybersecurity, Digital Identity, and Aerospace products and
solutions, in the most sustainable, responsible, and ethical manner.

Thales to strengthen Romania’s airspace protection

The Romanian General Directorate for Armaments and the French Direction Générale de l’Armement have
signed an agreement to supply twelve Thales GM200 Multi-Mission All-in-one (GM200MM/A) radars to
protect the Romanian airspace.

Aerospace Fabrication & Materials leads the aerospace industry in designing, manufacturing, and

aerospace and cryogenic environments.

## Aerospace Manufacturing & Fabrication

### What We Do


Aerospace Fabrication designs and fabricates soft goods and insulation solutions for extreme
environments. Our custom products protect vital instruments from the harsh vacuum of space, the
ultra-cold temperatures of cryogenic storage, and the intense heat of rocket engines and thrusters.

### What Sets Us Apart


At Aerospace Fabrication, we go beyond simply building materials—we deliver tailored solutions to
meet your exact needs. Whether for rockets, spacecraft components, or cryogenic applications, our
expert engineers work closely with you to develop innovative, high-performance products. We listen
to your requirements, assess every detail, and craft solutions that ensure reliability in extreme
environments.

### Built for the Extreme: Shop Our Products

Our high-performance aerospace materials are designed to protect your mission-critical equipment in
the harshest conditions. From sun shields that block intense heat and light to multilayer insulation
blankets that ensure thermal stability in cryogenic environments, our solutions don’t just withstand
extremes—they excel in them. Explore our products below and find the right fit for your needs.

Our expertise in sewing, taping, and sealing exceeds the standards of the cryogenic and aerospace
industries. We collaborate with top material suppliers to develop strong new materials that meet
ever-evolving environmental and thermal performance requirements, while continually refining
fabrication and attachment techniques. With engineers and fabricators working hand-in-hand, we
ensure superior quality and innovation in every product.

### **From NASA-Approved Materials to Commercial Aerospace Services**

With deep expertise in thin-film products and custom laminates, we collaborate with you to refine
your multilayer insulation design. Our team can provide guidance on material selection and
fabrication techniques, as well as create custom molds and mockups for precise 3D templating and
fabrication.

We work closely with every client to develop innovative insulation solutions using premier
production methods. Committed to quality, we meticulously craft each product to exceed expectations.

### **Aerospace Fabrication: Custom Solutions for Your Needs**

As part of our custom services, we can provide complete drawing and data packages to support your
project. Our MLI blankets can be templated, fabricated, and installed using our internal
documentation. We also manufacture and supply EVA hardware and MLI subassemblies for space
applications.

Our team assembles space-use-certified MLI lay-ups and blanket kits tailored to your specific needs.

fabrication and attachment techniques. With engineers and fabricators working hand-in-hand, we

### **From NASA-Approved Materials to Commercial Aerospace Services**

With deep expertise in thin-film products and custom laminates, we collaborate with you to refine
your multilayer insulation design. Our team can provide guidance on material selection and
fabrication techniques, as well as create custom molds and mockups for precise 3D templating and
fabrication.

We work closely with every client to develop innovative insulation solutions using premier
production methods. Committed to quality, we meticulously craft each product to exceed expectations.

### **Aerospace Fabrication: Custom Solutions for Your Needs**

As part of our custom services, we can provide complete drawing and data packages to support your
project. Our MLI blankets can be templated, fabricated, and installed using our internal
documentation. We also manufacture and supply EVA hardware and MLI subassemblies for space
applications.

Our team assembles space-use-certified MLI lay-ups and blanket kits tailored to your specific needs.

### From Concept to Completion

Whether you need guidance from your product’s initial vision or require the highest precision for
your project’s set specifications, we address quality at every step of the custom plastics machining
process.

1

### Engineering

With decades of experience in the industry, our dedicated craftsmen and close ties with leading
plastic manufacturers allow us to provide unrivaled knowledge and consulting in material selection,
sizing, manufacturing techniques and more to best meet your project’s needs.

2

### Design Conceptualization

Specialized in understanding and envisioning how to manufacture extremely complex designs, our team
can see beyond the concept through to the exact specifications and output of the finished product.
No matter the difficulty or application, we’ll bring your vision to life.

3

### Precision Machining

Utilizing our state-of-the-art technology alongside the expertise, care and precision of each
machinist and engineer, we apply the most appropriate machining and annealing techniques required to
perfectly construct your components down to an extreme tolerance of .002 mm.

### Quality Assurance

We address quality at every step of the manufacturing and planning process through strict adherence
to ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, FDA, FAA and ITAR standards. AIP’s metrology team ensures
precision by providing reliable and accurate inspection reports. As a result, customers quickly
develop confidence in AIP measurements.

4

### Finished Product

We take pride in making sure your parts are manufactured better than specification every time. It is
through our people, processes and proficiencies in which we promise precision for your plastic
components, with some of the shortest lead times in the industry.

### From Concept to Completion

Whether you need guidance from your product’s initial vision or require the highest precision for
your project’s set specifications, we address quality at every step of the custom plastics machining
process.

1

### Engineering

With decades of experience in the industry, our dedicated craftsmen and close ties with leading
plastic manufacturers allow us to provide unrivaled knowledge and consulting in material selection,
sizing, manufacturing techniques and more to best meet your project’s needs.

2

### Design Conceptualization

Specialized in understanding and envisioning how to manufacture extremely complex designs, our team
can see beyond the concept through to the exact specifications and output of the finished product.
No matter the difficulty or application, we’ll bring your vision to life.

3

### Precision Machining

Utilizing our state-of-the-art technology alongside the expertise, care and precision of each
machinist and engineer, we apply the most appropriate machining and annealing techniques required to
perfectly construct your components down to an extreme tolerance of .002 mm.

### Quality Assurance

We address quality at every step of the manufacturing and planning process through strict adherence
to ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, FDA, FAA and ITAR standards. AIP’s metrology team ensures
precision by providing reliable and accurate inspection reports. As a result, customers quickly
develop confidence in AIP measurements.

4

### Finished Product

We take pride in making sure your parts are manufactured better than specification every time. It is
through our people, processes and proficiencies in which we promise precision for your plastic
components, with some of the shortest lead times in the industry.

# ABOUT US

Foshan Shunde Zhichuang Machinery Co., Ltd

Foshan Shunde Zhichuang Machinery Co., Ltd., established in 2012, is a powerful factory specializing
in the research, development, manufacturing, and export of aluminum profile processing equipment. 
We have extensive experience in applications such as doors and windows, curtain walls, industrial
aluminum profiles, furniture profiles, and rail transit structural components.  Focusing on our
customers' core demands for "efficiency, precision, stability, and reliable delivery," we
continuously iterate on equipment structure and processing technology, striving to make every piece
of equipment "easier to use, more durable, and more worry-free."

Company Vision: To enable more processing plants worldwide to use more reliable, cost-effective, and
easier-to-maintain aluminum profile processing equipment.

**AME-3D is an ISO 9001:2015 UK-based 3D printing and low-volume manufacturing partner supporting
product development from concept to production with our own in-house product design team.**
We help engineers, designers, and manufacturers bring ideas to life using **in-house design, SLA,
SLS, FDM, MJF 3D printing, vacuum casting, and finishing services** — all delivered from the UK with
fast lead times.
With **design, manufacturing, and finishing under one roof**, AME-3D reduces risk, shortens
development cycles, and delivers production-ready parts for industries including **automotive,
medical, subsea, aerospace, consumer products, and industrial manufacturing**.

## *Who are AME-3D?*

## 25+ Years Experience

Experienced, reliable & professional.

We are a full-service partner, a leading 3D printing UK company, guiding clients through their
product development journey. We specialise in design, prototyping, and low-volume production,
helping businesses and innovators bring their ideas to life through a range of technologies
including 3D printing, model making & vacuum casting. Our expertise enables a seamless transition
from initial ideas to functional prototypes and final production runs.

With a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation, we work closely with clients to refine designs,
test functionality, and manufacture precision products and parts in small batches—ideal for market
testing, custom applications, or limited-release products. Whether you're a startup or an
established brand, we provide the support and expertise needed to turn your vision into a tangible
product.
[ About Us ][89]

## *Why choose AME-3D?*

## Your Trusted Partner in Product Design, Development & Manufacturing

We’re a solutions partner, committed to supporting our customers at every stage of their product
development journey. With our ISO 9001:2015 certification, we ensure high-quality, cost-effective
solutions that align with project budgets while maintaining quick lead times.

Our expertise is accessible at multiple levels, whether you need reverse engineering for an existing
part, a prototype, or a low-volume production run. We take a flexible, customer-centric approach,
adapting to each project's unique requirements to deliver efficient, reliable, and innovative
manufacturing solutions.

[ Meet the team ][90]
[Product Design Engineering]
[Low Volume Production]

## *What Technologies Do You Have?*

## Full In-House Capability

Our UK-based suite of manufacturing facilities gives you access to 3D printing (SLA, SLS, MJF, FDM &
LCD), vacuum casting services, and a team of skilled design engineers and technicians.

This fully integrated setup ensures seamless production, high-quality results, and cost-effective
solutions—all with the efficiency and flexibility your project needs.

#### FAQs

 

### **
### 
### What services does AME-3D provide?
### 
### **

AME-3D provides UK-based product design, 3D printing, rapid prototyping, and low-volume
manufacturing services. Our capabilities include **in-house design, SLA, SLS, LCD, MJF, FDM 3D
printing, vacuum casting, and finishing**, allowing customers to move from concept to production
with one supplier.

### **
### 
### Who do you work with?
### 
### **

We work with **engineers, designers, startups, and established manufacturers** across industries
including **automotive, medical, subsea, aerospace, consumer products, film & TV, and industrial
manufacturing**. Whether you need a single prototype, a short production run or reverse engineering
legacy parts, we can support your project.

### **
### 
### Do you offer design support as well as manufacturing?
### 
### **

Yes. AME-3D offers **in-house design and design-for-manufacture (DFM) support**, helping customers
refine CAD models, improve printability, and reduce production risk before parts are made.

### **
### 
### Can you support low-volume or short-run production?
### 
### **

Yes. We specialise in **low-volume manufacturing and short production runs**, using technologies
such as **vacuum casting and additive manufacturing** to bridge the gap between prototyping and
full-scale production.

### **
### 
### Where are your parts manufactured?
### 
### **

All parts are **designed, printed, cast, and finished in the UK**. Local manufacturing allows for
faster lead times, clearer communication, and greater control compared to overseas suppliers.

#### FAQs

 

### **
### 
### What services does AME-3D provide?
### 
### **

AME-3D provides UK-based product design, 3D printing, rapid prototyping, and low-volume
manufacturing services. Our capabilities include **in-house design, SLA, SLS, LCD, MJF, FDM 3D
printing, vacuum casting, and finishing**, allowing customers to move from concept to production
with one supplier.

### **
### 
### Who do you work with?
### 
### **

We work with **engineers, designers, startups, and established manufacturers** across industries
including **automotive, medical, subsea, aerospace, consumer products, film & TV, and industrial
manufacturing**. Whether you need a single prototype, a short production run or reverse engineering
legacy parts, we can support your project.

### **
### 
### Do you offer design support as well as manufacturing?
### 
### **

Yes. AME-3D offers **in-house design and design-for-manufacture (DFM) support**, helping customers
refine CAD models, improve printability, and reduce production risk before parts are made.

### **
### 
### Can you support low-volume or short-run production?
### 
### **

Yes. We specialise in **low-volume manufacturing and short production runs**, using technologies
such as **vacuum casting and additive manufacturing** to bridge the gap between prototyping and
full-scale production.

### **
### 
### Where are your parts manufactured?
### 
### **

All parts are **designed, printed, cast, and finished in the UK**. Local manufacturing allows for
faster lead times, clearer communication, and greater control compared to overseas suppliers.

There is no limit to our customer base. We provide solutions for commercial aerospace, defense,

## Additive Manufacturing

Ascent Aerospace is answering the industry’s call and taking additive manufacturing technology to a
new level by leveraging its deep expertise in tooling to commercialize production ready additive
solutions. As a new tooling option for its customers, Ascent intends to utilize its recent
investment of a large scale additive manufacturing machine to bring tools such as layup molds,
masters, trimming/drilling fixtures and vacuum holding fixtures to market faster than ever before.

[ Click here to learn more ][45]

## QUALITY COMMITMENT

Our team adheres to the highest quality and compliance standards to maintain the integrity,
accuracy, and reproducibility of our quality activities. Our company policies and procedures comply
with AS9100 and ISO 9001 international standards.

# Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing

Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing Aerospace Company Engineering
Consulting & Parts Manufacturing Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing
[Contact Us ][66]

#### Aerospace Consultant & Parts Manufacture

**Specialized in Engineering & Certification of General Aviation, Commercial Aviation, Special
Mission Aircraft & Parts Manufacturing**

[Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of propeller airflow around aircraft]

#### Welcome to Aero Tech Aviation Design, LLC (ATAD)

We are an Aerospace Engineering Consulting and Parts Manufacturing company specializing in
engineering, certification, and parts manufacturing of general aviation, commercial aviation, and
special mission aircraft. With FAA PMA, we also produce FAA-approved airworthy parts, assemblies,
and installation kits. We provide turn-key solutions to allow our clients to do what they do best.

[CONTACT US][67]

**Celebrating Over a Quarter Century in the Aerospace Industry!**

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

[Close-up of hands writing in a binder, glasses nearby.]

ATAD has over a quarter century of experience in certification and is working with the FAA to become
an ODA. Our experience working on a wide variety of programs and projects has made our Program
Management and Organization (PMO) an industry leader in processes and capabilities. From small
single part PMA projects to full startup TC programs, we have years of PMO and Certification
experience.

[Learn More][68]

#### Engineering, Drafting & Design

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

[Gears and engineering blueprints; drafting and design process]

ATAD has a strong history in Structures, Mechanical Systems, Propulsion, and Aerodynamics, Design,
and Drafting. Our team members have years of industry experience, formal training, degrees and have
even taught some of these subjects.

[Learn More][69]

#### Parts Manufacturing

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Parts Manufacturing

[Black Viking microphone stand with gold logo]

ATAD provides Parts Manufacturing for the following areas; FAA PMA Parts & Assemblies, Military,
Experimental/Proto-type, and Tooling. We supply OEMs, MROs, and have a products site with parts
available for sale to owner/operators.

[Learn More][70]
[CNC milling machines in operation, showcasing precision metal cutting and machining processes.]

#### ATAD Capability Overview

Aero Tech Aviation Design (ATAD) is a turn-key engineering and certification specialty services
provider serving the aerospace industry since 1998. We are also an FAA-approved Production Approval
Holder with a wide range of manufacturing capabilities. From humble beginnings, as structures
designers, we have grown to include Systems Engineering, Propulsion, Certification, Performance
Analysis, Structural Analysis, Safety Systems, testing Support, Production Support, Tooling Design
Support, Field Support, Parts Manufacturing (PMA), Military Parts Manufacturing, Prototype, Build to
Print, and more.

# Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing

Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing Aerospace Company Engineering
Consulting & Parts Manufacturing Aerospace Company Engineering Consulting & Parts Manufacturing
[Contact Us ][66]

#### Aerospace Consultant & Parts Manufacture

**Specialized in Engineering & Certification of General Aviation, Commercial Aviation, Special
Mission Aircraft & Parts Manufacturing**

[Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of propeller airflow around aircraft]

#### Welcome to Aero Tech Aviation Design, LLC (ATAD)

We are an Aerospace Engineering Consulting and Parts Manufacturing company specializing in
engineering, certification, and parts manufacturing of general aviation, commercial aviation, and
special mission aircraft. With FAA PMA, we also produce FAA-approved airworthy parts, assemblies,
and installation kits. We provide turn-key solutions to allow our clients to do what they do best.

[CONTACT US][67]

**Celebrating Over a Quarter Century in the Aerospace Industry!**

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

[Close-up of hands writing in a binder, glasses nearby.]

ATAD has over a quarter century of experience in certification and is working with the FAA to become
an ODA. Our experience working on a wide variety of programs and projects has made our Program
Management and Organization (PMO) an industry leader in processes and capabilities. From small
single part PMA projects to full startup TC programs, we have years of PMO and Certification
experience.

[Learn More][68]

#### Engineering, Drafting & Design

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Certification & Program Management

[Gears and engineering blueprints; drafting and design process]

ATAD has a strong history in Structures, Mechanical Systems, Propulsion, and Aerodynamics, Design,
and Drafting. Our team members have years of industry experience, formal training, degrees and have
even taught some of these subjects.

[Learn More][69]

#### Parts Manufacturing

#### Certification & Program Management

#### Parts Manufacturing

[Black Viking microphone stand with gold logo]

ATAD provides Parts Manufacturing for the following areas; FAA PMA Parts & Assemblies, Military,
Experimental/Proto-type, and Tooling. We supply OEMs, MROs, and have a products site with parts
available for sale to owner/operators.

[Learn More][70]
[CNC milling machines in operation, showcasing precision metal cutting and machining processes.]

#### ATAD Capability Overview

Aero Tech Aviation Design (ATAD) is a turn-key engineering and certification specialty services
provider serving the aerospace industry since 1998. We are also an FAA-approved Production Approval
Holder with a wide range of manufacturing capabilities. From humble beginnings, as structures
designers, we have grown to include Systems Engineering, Propulsion, Certification, Performance
Analysis, Structural Analysis, Safety Systems, testing Support, Production Support, Tooling Design
Support, Field Support, Parts Manufacturing (PMA), Military Parts Manufacturing, Prototype, Build to
Print, and more.

# Precision Turbine Parts Manufacturer

# Excellent Quality and Competitive Pricing

# Delightful Customer Service

## BVPL Profile

With over 35 years of unwavering expertise in precision engineering, we proudly stand as a leading
Gas Turbine Parts Manufacturer. Our commitment to excellence spans two decades of crafting engine
and structural components for aircraft, industrial gas turbines, and steam turbines, solidifying our
reputation as a trusted partner in critical applications.

#### [Know More ][17]

### Go with BVPL

We are an An AS9100D (Aerospace industry certification) & BS EN ISO 9001:2015 certified company with
experience in manufacturing high precision parts. We have trained and qualified affordable resources
and material supply chain giving you excellent value for money. All our customer from the start of
our foray into the aerospace, gas turbine and steam turbine industries continue to work with us to
this day, bearing testimony to our delightful customer service

#### [Know More ][18]

### Product And Services

We manufacture aero structures, vanes, blades and tooling components for the aerospace industry. We
also manufacture capital parts such as shrouds and diaphragms for the **[Gas Turbine][19]** Industry
and specialize in making blades for steam turbines.

#### [Know More ][20]

> “
> 
> Zero Defect, 100% Quality Rating
> 
> Toyoda (subsidiary of Toyota Group, parent company of Toyota Motor Corporation)

> “
> 
> Keeping in mind our tight schedule and the criticality of components, your active support and
> timely delivery of quality parts, in spite of testing circumstances, has strengthened our efforts
> and helped us achieve our divisional sales target. I sincerely thank you again for your invaluable
> contribution and am looking forward to working with you in future endeavors
> 
> Engine division, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited

> “
> 
> This has been a great project and thank you and your team for excellent quality component supply!
> 
> A UK Aerospace Company

> “
> 
> Great company to work with. They are experts at new product development and respond quickly to any
> queries. They follow an excellent inspection methodology and assure 100% quality every time.
> 
> A US Gas Turbine Services company

#### We will be happy to provide/source any of these services along with our customer promise of
#### excellent quality, competitive pricing and delightful customer service.

## NOTICE: AIRSPACE RESTRICTION *2ND JUNE – 4TH JUNE, 2022*

To ensure the safety and security of all guests, staff and performers at Her Majesty the Queen’s
Jubilee Air Show, the Director‐General of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Cayman Islands (CAACI)
has restricted the airspace surrounding the event.
The flight of all aircraft, including small unmanned aircraft (SUA), also known as Drones, is
prohibited within 3 (three) nautical miles of the Air Show, offshore at Seven Mile Public Beach from
surface to 6000 ft above mean sea level between 0700 – 1900 hours local time on Thursday 2nd and
Friday 3rd June 2022.

The flight of all aircraft, including small unmanned aircraft (SUA), also known as Drones, is
prohibited within 3 (three) nautical miles of the Charles Kirkconnell International Airport, Cayman
Brac from surface to 6000 ft above mean sea level between 1100 – 1400 hours local time on Saturday
4th June 2022.

[Restricted Airspace Notification 001-2022][50]

aircraft to exercise heightened vigilance when planning or conducting flight operations in, or in
the vicinity of, the Middle East region.

airspace restrictions, and disruptions to air navigation services.

## NOTICE: AIRSPACE RESTRICTION *2ND JUNE – 4TH JUNE, 2022*

To ensure the safety and security of all guests, staff and performers at Her Majesty the Queen’s
Jubilee Air Show, the Director‐General of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Cayman Islands (CAACI)
has restricted the airspace surrounding the event.
The flight of all aircraft, including small unmanned aircraft (SUA), also known as Drones, is
prohibited within 3 (three) nautical miles of the Air Show, offshore at Seven Mile Public Beach from
surface to 6000 ft above mean sea level between 0700 – 1900 hours local time on Thursday 2nd and
Friday 3rd June 2022.

The flight of all aircraft, including small unmanned aircraft (SUA), also known as Drones, is
prohibited within 3 (three) nautical miles of the Charles Kirkconnell International Airport, Cayman
Brac from surface to 6000 ft above mean sea level between 1100 – 1400 hours local time on Saturday
4th June 2022.

**Our Manufacturing **
**Services**
**Let our CNC manufacturing team work for you! **

Chinamilling Online provides a wide range of services for processing custom parts, such as die
casting, 3D printing, CNC milling, and CNC turning.

Modern 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis CNC machines as well as cutting-edge 3D printing technology are
available at our facility. This enables any custom parts processing project involving both metal and
plastic materials to be handled effectively by our skilled team.

Our online CNC machining services are perfect for both mass production and prototyping because they
can be tailored to meet a wide range of needs.

**Why Choose Chinamilling?**
With Chinamilling's outstanding manufacturing services, you can turn your idea into a reality. We
specialize in using our sophisticated and effective manufacturing capabilities to create both simple
and complex prototypes as well as end-use components. Our staff is committed to creating goods that
satisfy exacting tolerance and quality requirements, guaranteeing the dependability and accuracy of
every product we produce. Being one of China's top on-demand manufacturers, we take great
satisfaction in offering excellent solutions that are customized to meet your unique requirements.

## Expertise and Experience

Our team has a wealth of experience in rapid prototyping. We are a team of dedicated, highly skilled
professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality prototypes.
 
 
 

## Efficiency and Speed

We recognize the significance of product development. With our assistance, you can turn your
concepts into working prototypes very fast, cutting down on the amount of time it takes to realize
your idea.
 

## Supply chains are simplified

Chinamilling enables on-demand production of products. This eliminates the need for large
inventories or complex supply chains. As a result, inventory management becomes more efficient, and
storage costs decrease.
 
 

## Cost-Effective Solutions

We provide cost-effective solutions that help you save time and money. Our services allow for
earlier design iterations and help you steer clear of costly errors. Over time, this results in
considerable savings.
 

## Quality Assurance

To guarantee that the finished product satisfies your requirements, we place a high priority on the
quality of our prototypes. Utilizing cutting-edge tools and technologies, we ensure the
highest-quality prototypes by paying meticulous attention to every detail and putting strict quality
control procedures in place.

## Good Quality!

Chinamilling puts quality first and foremost. Our expert engineers and technicians are dedicated to
producing faultless die-cast components. We use stringent quality control techniques to ensure that
each part is defect-free.
 
**Professional Experience And Testing Equipment Ensure Part Quality!**
Selecting the ideal CNC machining partner is essential, and at Chinamilling, our team of
professionals brings a wealth of experience to every project. We can handle even the most difficult
design problems thanks to this expertise. With years of experience, we are able to manufacture
components of the highest quality with precision and accuracy because we understand the finer points
of CNC cutting. Our dedication to upholding the highest standards of quality in the sector is
validated by our ISO 9001:2015 certification.

Precision CNC Machining Partner from Prototype to Production

From early prototypes to full production, DEK supports precision CNC machining programs that require
stable processes, controlled quality, and reliable lead times for high-precision industries in
Europe and North America.

[Request For Quote][142]
ISO 9001 | ISO 13485:2016 |  AS9100D Certified 

## Welcome to DEK Manufacturing, Your Trusted Partner in High Precision Machining

DEK Manufacturing is a precision CNC machining company providing support from early prototypes to
full production. We operate under controlled manufacturing processes, certified quality systems, and
documented inspection procedures to ensure consistent and repeatable results.

We serve aerospace, medical, and industrial OEMs across Europe and North America, helping customers
meet tight tolerances, maintain supply stability, and manage production programs with confidence.

## Engineering-Led Precision Machining Solutions

At DEK, we approach manufacturing as an engineering discipline. We don't just follow drawings; we
partner with your team to solve technical challenges, optimize designs for performance and
manufacturability, and deliver precision components that perform as intended—from prototype through
production.

## Complex Geometry Machining

Single-setup 5-axis machining maintains positional relationships on complex features, achieving
±0.01 mm profile control and true position stability across deep cavities, compound angles, and
multi-face geometries, eliminating cumulative errors from multiple setups or secondary operations.
[
View 5 Axis Machining Capabilities
][143]

## Micro Precision Components

We machine sub-10 mm components with tolerances down to ±0.003 mm, controlling concentricity,
runout, and surface integrity on miniature shafts, pins, and housings using Swiss-type lathes and
micro-milling processes validated for batch repeatability.

## Hard Material Machining

Proven processes for Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, 17-4PH, 316LVM, and PEEK ensure dimensional stability,
controlled tool wear, and consistent surface quality on high-stress components where heat, hardness,
and deformation risk typically drive scrap.

## Large Structural Parts

Capability for large-format components up to ~1000 mm, with deformation control, stable fixturing,
and process sequencing to maintain flatness, straightness, and critical datums across thick-section
aluminum and steel structural parts.

## Fit-Critical Assemblies

We machine mating components as controlled sets, managing shaft-bore fits, parallelism, and
coaxiality to ±0.005 mm, ensuring predictable assembly behavior, reduced hand-fitting, and
first-pass assembly success in functional mechanical and electromechanical systems.

## Production-Grade Consistency

Processes, tooling, and inspection methods used for prototypes are identical in production, enabling
seamless scale-up without requalification, maintaining dimensional consistency, material
traceability, and process stability across low- to mid-volume production programs.

# Precision Machining Solutions for Demanding Industries

Every industry has its own set of challenges, standards, and critical requirements. We apply our
engineering-first approach and precision machining expertise to meet these specific demands,
delivering components that perform reliably where it matters most.

Precision machining of aluminum and titanium components for non-flight-critical aerospace systems,
including cabin interiors and structural support parts, with controlled processes and documentation
support for regulated supply chains.

# Medical Devices

High-precision machining of stainless steel, titanium, and engineering plastics for medical devices
and equipment, supporting tight tolerances, surface integrity, and validated processes aligned with
regulated manufacturing environments.
[
View Medical Devices Solutions
][145]

# Robotics

Machining of complex, fit-critical components for robotic joints, housings, and motion systems,
maintaining dimensional stability, alignment, and repeatability across precision mechanical and
electromechanical assemblies.
[
View Robotics Solutions
][146]

# Semiconductor Equipments

Precision machining of aluminum and specialty material components for semiconductor and electronics
manufacturing equipment, supporting tight geometric tolerances, surface quality, and assembly
accuracy in clean and controlled environments.
[
View Semiconductor Solutions
][147]

# Industrial Equipment

Manufacturing of precision components for industrial machinery and automation equipment, focusing on
dimensional consistency, durability, and reliable performance in long-term production programs.
[
View Industrial Equipment Solutions
][148]

# Energy

Machining of high-strength and heat-resistant components for energy, power, and advanced industrial
systems, where material performance, dimensional stability, and process consistency are critical to
system reliability.
[
View Energy Solutions
][149]

# Quality System Built for Precision and Repeatability

DEK operates a documented quality management system covering IQC, IPQC, FAI, OQC, SPC, and CAPA,
controlling dimensional accuracy, process stability, and inspection consistency across all
production stages.

All machining programs are supported by defined inspection plans, calibrated measurement equipment,
and full lot-level traceability to ensure parts conform to specification before shipment.

Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100D, supporting regulated,
high-precision manufacturing programs that require stable processes and repeatable results.

[
Learn more about our Quality System
][150]

# Engineering Support from Start to Finish

DEK provides integrated engineering support throughout quotation, manufacturing, and production
execution.

Our engineers collaborate with customer teams on DFM feedback, material selection, and process
definition to reduce manufacturing risk and align design intent with stable, repeatable processes.

Engineering, quality, and sales operate as a coordinated team to ensure clear communication and
consistent execution across the full manufacturing lifecycle.

Precision CNC Machining Partner from Prototype to Production

From early prototypes to full production, DEK supports precision CNC machining programs that require
stable processes, controlled quality, and reliable lead times for high-precision industries in
Europe and North America.

[Request For Quote][142]
ISO 9001 | ISO 13485:2016 |  AS9100D Certified 

## Welcome to DEK Manufacturing, Your Trusted Partner in High Precision Machining

DEK Manufacturing is a precision CNC machining company providing support from early prototypes to
full production. We operate under controlled manufacturing processes, certified quality systems, and
documented inspection procedures to ensure consistent and repeatable results.

We serve aerospace, medical, and industrial OEMs across Europe and North America, helping customers
meet tight tolerances, maintain supply stability, and manage production programs with confidence.
20+
Years in Precision Machining
1.2M+
Critical Parts Machined Annually
2300+

98.6%+

±0.005mm

Prototype Lead Time

## Engineering-Led Precision Machining Solutions

At DEK, we approach manufacturing as an engineering discipline. We don't just follow drawings; we
partner with your team to solve technical challenges, optimize designs for performance and
manufacturability, and deliver precision components that perform as intended—from prototype through
production.

## Complex Geometry Machining

Single-setup 5-axis machining maintains positional relationships on complex features, achieving
±0.01 mm profile control and true position stability across deep cavities, compound angles, and
multi-face geometries, eliminating cumulative errors from multiple setups or secondary operations.
[
View 5 Axis Machining Capabilities
][143]

## Micro Precision Components

We machine sub-10 mm components with tolerances down to ±0.003 mm, controlling concentricity,
runout, and surface integrity on miniature shafts, pins, and housings using Swiss-type lathes and
micro-milling processes validated for batch repeatability.

## Hard Material Machining

Proven processes for Ti-6Al-4V, Inconel 718, 17-4PH, 316LVM, and PEEK ensure dimensional stability,
controlled tool wear, and consistent surface quality on high-stress components where heat, hardness,
and deformation risk typically drive scrap.

## Large Structural Parts

Capability for large-format components up to ~1000 mm, with deformation control, stable fixturing,
and process sequencing to maintain flatness, straightness, and critical datums across thick-section
aluminum and steel structural parts.

## Fit-Critical Assemblies

We machine mating components as controlled sets, managing shaft-bore fits, parallelism, and
coaxiality to ±0.005 mm, ensuring predictable assembly behavior, reduced hand-fitting, and
first-pass assembly success in functional mechanical and electromechanical systems.

## Production-Grade Consistency

Processes, tooling, and inspection methods used for prototypes are identical in production, enabling
seamless scale-up without requalification, maintaining dimensional consistency, material
traceability, and process stability across low- to mid-volume production programs.

# Precision Machining Solutions for Demanding Industries

Every industry has its own set of challenges, standards, and critical requirements. We apply our
engineering-first approach and precision machining expertise to meet these specific demands,
delivering components that perform reliably where it matters most.

# Aerospace

Precision machining of aluminum and titanium components for non-flight-critical aerospace systems,
including cabin interiors and structural support parts, with controlled processes and documentation
support for regulated supply chains.

View Aerospace Solutions
][144]

# Medical Devices

High-precision machining of stainless steel, titanium, and engineering plastics for medical devices
and equipment, supporting tight tolerances, surface integrity, and validated processes aligned with
regulated manufacturing environments.
[
View Medical Devices Solutions
][145]

# Robotics

Machining of complex, fit-critical components for robotic joints, housings, and motion systems,
maintaining dimensional stability, alignment, and repeatability across precision mechanical and
electromechanical assemblies.
[
View Robotics Solutions
][146]

# Semiconductor Equipments

Precision machining of aluminum and specialty material components for semiconductor and electronics
manufacturing equipment, supporting tight geometric tolerances, surface quality, and assembly
accuracy in clean and controlled environments.
[
View Semiconductor Solutions
][147]

# Industrial Equipment

Manufacturing of precision components for industrial machinery and automation equipment, focusing on
dimensional consistency, durability, and reliable performance in long-term production programs.
[
View Industrial Equipment Solutions
][148]

# Energy

Machining of high-strength and heat-resistant components for energy, power, and advanced industrial
systems, where material performance, dimensional stability, and process consistency are critical to
system reliability.
[
View Energy Solutions
][149]

# Quality System Built for Precision and Repeatability

DEK operates a documented quality management system covering IQC, IPQC, FAI, OQC, SPC, and CAPA,
controlling dimensional accuracy, process stability, and inspection consistency across all
production stages.

All machining programs are supported by defined inspection plans, calibrated measurement equipment,
and full lot-level traceability to ensure parts conform to specification before shipment.

Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100D, supporting regulated,
high-precision manufacturing programs that require stable processes and repeatable results.

[
Learn more about our Quality System
][150]

# Engineering Support from Start to Finish

DEK provides integrated engineering support throughout quotation, manufacturing, and production
execution.

Our engineers collaborate with customer teams on DFM feedback, material selection, and process
definition to reduce manufacturing risk and align design intent with stable, repeatable processes.

Engineering, quality, and sales operate as a coordinated team to ensure clear communication and
consistent execution across the full manufacturing lifecycle.

## GKN Aerospace global capabilities

[GKN Video Thumbnail] [ Play Video ][72]

## Two market-leading aerospace divisions

[GTF Engine at Paris Airshow 2019 Static Display30]

### Engines

Our industry-leading Engines division is a trusted technology partner to all global engine
manufacturers, offering differentiated aero-engine products, processes and IP. GKN Aerospace is
uniquely positioned for next-generation platforms. Its exceptional portfolio of engine partnerships
is entering the attractive aftermarket phase served by its fast-growing repair business.

[ Find more about Engines ][73]

#### Customers

Engines OEMs

#### Technology

High performance structural and rotating engine components; parts repair; High speed machining,
Composite technologies, Laser Welding and Additive Fabrication, Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation industry and military aviation industry. The
after-market includes airlines. The end market also encompasses the space industry

#### 2025 revenue

*£1.6bn*

#### Employees

*4,000*

#### Manufacturing sites

*11*
[A350 XWB Airbus]

### Airframes

Our design-led Airframes division offers structures technology, electrical distribution systems,
transparencies, and ice-protection systems from a global industrial footprint. It has embedded
customer positions on all today’s major aircraft, and its superior technology means it is well
placed for the next-generation across both the civil and defence markets.

[ Find more about Aerostructures ][74]

#### Customers

Airframe OEMs

#### Technology

Lightweight composite and metallic structures; electrical distribution systems; landing gear
components High-speed Machining, Metal bonding, Composite technologies, Additive Manufacturing,
Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation, military aviation, business aviation and advanced
air mobility

#### 2025 revenue

*£2bn*

#### Employees

*12,000*

#### Manufacturing Sites

*21*

GKN Aerospace is the original aerospace innovator, with more than 265 years of industrial heritage

[ Explore innovation ][79]
[48 Pax KP (3)Latest]

## Sustainability

Committed to doing the right thing. Our approach to sustainability can be summed up in one phrase:
doing the right thing – by our people, our planet, and our technology. This means acting in a safe,
ethical manner in everything we do.

[ Explore sustainability ][80]

## Markets

[Home Banner Engines 1600X800]

### Engines

If you’ve ever flown anywhere, chances are we’ve already met. Surely, you’ve seen the large turbines
hanging beneath the aircraft’s wings. Those are the engines – and that’s our business.

[ Find out more ][81]
[Hero Banner Civil 1600X800]

### Civil

We provide wing structures, fuselages, empennages, transparencies, electrical wiring systems and
components for major platforms ranging from helicopters to business jets to the most used single
aisle aircraft and most advanced eVTOLs in the world.

[ Find out more ][82]
[Hero Banner Defense 1600X800]

### Defence

At GKN Aerospace we shape the Future of Flight. With our innovative technologies and our unique
global network, we provide our defence customers across the world with systems and components that
make aircraft fly faster and further.

[ Find out more ][83]
[Bristol Robot]

## Our differentiators

Why GKN Aerospace and what makes us unique. We look beyond immediate market requirements, assessing
the impact of environmental and technological trends on aviation and passengers.

[ Find out more ][84]

[Colleagues on shop floor in Hoogeveen 0563]

## Our locations

Today we are truly global, with 16,000 employees in 32 manufacturing locations in 12 countries
around the world.

[ Discover our locations ][85]

[Inspecting Space Nozzle in Trollhättan]

We design and manufacture innovative smart aerospace systems and components.

## Two market-leading aerospace divisions

### Engines

Our industry-leading Engines division is a trusted technology partner to all global engine
manufacturers, offering differentiated aero-engine products, processes and IP. GKN Aerospace is
uniquely positioned for next-generation platforms. Its exceptional portfolio of engine partnerships
is entering the attractive aftermarket phase served by its fast-growing repair business.

Engines OEMs

High performance structural and rotating engine components; parts repair; High speed machining,
Composite technologies, Laser Welding and Additive Fabrication, Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation industry and military aviation industry. The
after-market includes airlines. The end market also encompasses the space industry

## Your Challenges, Our Engineered Solutions

HEICO Corporation (NYSE: HEI and HEI.A) established in 1957, is a dynamic and expanding
technology-driven company specializing in aerospace, industrial, defense, and electronics sectors. 

Flourishing through a commitment to innovation and cost-effective solutions, HEICO’s products are
integral components on large commercial, regional, business, and military aircraft, as well as
diverse applications like industrial turbines, targeting systems, missiles, and electro-optical
devices.

Operating in two distinct segments, the Flight Support Group and the Electronic Technologies Group,
HEICO Corporation remains at the forefront of technological advancements, providing essential
solutions across multiple industries.

## HEICO Flight Support Group

HEICO’s Flight Support Group is a globally recognized leader in aerospace aftermarket solutions,
specializing in FAA-PMA parts, DER repairs, and aircraft component manufacturing. We design and
manufacture cost-effective aircraft replacement parts, perform proprietary Designated Engineering
Representative (DER) repairs and overhauls, and provide specialty product manufacturing and
distribution services.

Trusted by major airlines, OEMs, and the U.S. military, HEICO supplies critical aircraft components
and aerospace systems. We also manufacture products for many of the world’s leading aerospace and
defense original equipment manufacturers. Our collaborative partnerships with global carriers drive
the development of FAA-approved parts and aerospace aftermarket innovations that enhance operational
efficiency and reduce maintenance costs.

[ Learn more ][67]

### HEICO Parts Group

HEICO Parts Group (HPG) is the world’s largest independent supplier of FAA-PMA approved engine and
aircraft component parts, with a portfolio spanning nearly every engine platform and ATA chapter.

Backed by over 19,500 FAA approvals and producing more than 500 new highly engineered parts
annually, HPG is more than a parts provider—it’s a leader in aircraft component manufacturing and
aerospace aftermarket innovation.

[ Learn more / Access Customer Login ][68]

HEICO Repair Group (HRG) is positioned as the leading independent provider of flight-critical repair
and overhaul services, specializing in over 32,000 aircraft accessory components. This includes
Hydraulic, Electro-mechanical, Pneumatic, Avionic, Electronic, Power Generation and Structural
aircraft sections.

As the preeminent global provider of independent Component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO)
and Asset Management Services, HRG’s success is credited to the exceptional capabilities of its team
in thoroughly comprehending customer requirements and delivering customized solutions precisely
tailored to meet their needs. We offer advanced repair solutions, including the development of over
700 FAA-DER repairs annually.

## Your Challenges, Our Engineered Solutions

HEICO Corporation (NYSE: HEI and HEI.A) established in 1957, is a dynamic and expanding
technology-driven company specializing in aerospace, industrial, defense, and electronics sectors. 

Flourishing through a commitment to innovation and cost-effective solutions, HEICO’s products are
integral components on large commercial, regional, business, and military aircraft, as well as
diverse applications like industrial turbines, targeting systems, missiles, and electro-optical
devices.

Operating in two distinct segments, the Flight Support Group and the Electronic Technologies Group,
HEICO Corporation remains at the forefront of technological advancements, providing essential
solutions across multiple industries.

## HEICO Flight Support Group

HEICO’s Flight Support Group is a globally recognized leader in aerospace aftermarket solutions,
specializing in FAA-PMA parts, DER repairs, and aircraft component manufacturing. We design and
manufacture cost-effective aircraft replacement parts, perform proprietary Designated Engineering
Representative (DER) repairs and overhauls, and provide specialty product manufacturing and
distribution services.

Trusted by major airlines, OEMs, and the U.S. military, HEICO supplies critical aircraft components
and aerospace systems. We also manufacture products for many of the world’s leading aerospace and
defense original equipment manufacturers. Our collaborative partnerships with global carriers drive
the development of FAA-approved parts and aerospace aftermarket innovations that enhance operational
efficiency and reduce maintenance costs.

[ Learn more ][67]

### HEICO Parts Group

HEICO Parts Group (HPG) is the world’s largest independent supplier of FAA-PMA approved engine and
aircraft component parts, with a portfolio spanning nearly every engine platform and ATA chapter.

Backed by over 19,500 FAA approvals and producing more than 500 new highly engineered parts
annually, HPG is more than a parts provider—it’s a leader in aircraft component manufacturing and
aerospace aftermarket innovation.

[ Learn more / Access Customer Login ][68]

### HEICO Repair Group

HEICO Repair Group (HRG) is positioned as the leading independent provider of flight-critical repair
and overhaul services, specializing in over 32,000 aircraft accessory components. This includes
Hydraulic, Electro-mechanical, Pneumatic, Avionic, Electronic, Power Generation and Structural
aircraft sections.

As the preeminent global provider of independent Component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO)
and Asset Management Services, HRG’s success is credited to the exceptional capabilities of its team
in thoroughly comprehending customer requirements and delivering customized solutions precisely
tailored to meet their needs. We offer advanced repair solutions, including the development of over
700 FAA-DER repairs annually.

* [Technologies][51]
  * Manufacturing Processes
  * [Metal Part Production][52]
    * Metal Part Production
      
      Metal part production is an inclusive terminology that refers to several manufacturing
      techniques to get the desired end product from raw metal materials. Usually, bending, cutting,
      assembling, and shaping are the most crucial steps for metal manufacturing. It can be
      perfectly molded into top-quality metal parts, whether you use a hard or soft metal material.
      * [Forging ][53]
      * [Die Casting][54]
      * [Investment Casting ][55]
      * [Sand Casting][56]
      * [Powder Metallurgy ][57]
      * [Metal Stamping ][58]
      * [Metal Extrusion ][59]
    * Top Stories
      
      Forging is a technique that deals with the shaping of metals by hammering, rolling, and
      pressing. In this article, you'll learn about various forging methods.
      
      [Read more][60]
  * [Sheet and Tube Fabrication][61]
    * Sheet and Tube Fabrication
      
      Sheet metal fabrication is a technology in which flat sheet metal is converted into different
      parts. However, in the case of tube fabrication, metal pipes or tubes are formed by curving
      the metals at different angles. Primarily, aluminum alloys, stainless steel, and non-alloy
      steel sheets create several sheet metal parts such as brackets, enclosures, curls, and more.
      * [Sheet Cutting ][62]
      * [Laser Cutting][63]
      * [Waterjet Cutting ][64]
      * [Plasma Cutting][65]
      * [Tube Bending ][66]
      * [Laser Tube Cutting ][67]
      * [Wire EDM ][68]
    * Top Stories
      
      The sheet metal fabrication process produces the metal parts by using various techniques that
      alter the shape of the flat sheet metal to the required structure. Let's dive into the post to
      absorb more details.
      
      [Read more][69]
  * [Injection Molding][70]
    * Injection Molding
      
      The manufacturing process used for creating components by injecting the liquid metal into a
      mold with the help of specialized syringes is called the injection molding process. Once the
      molten metal hardens, it shapes the mold used in the specific process. We usually recommend
      this process for large-scale productions and competitive pricing.
      * [Plastic Injection Molding][71]
      * [ Rubber Injection Molding][72]
      * [Overmolding][73]
      * [Insert Molding][74]
      * [Urethane Molding][75]

  * [3D Printing][85]
    * 3D Printing
      
      3D printing is an additive manufacturing technology through which three-dimensional solid
      parts are created from a digital design or a CAD file. Several thin layers of material fuse to
      produce the end product. By 3D printing machines, manufacturers can form complex-shaped
      prototypes without using much more material than other manufacturing processes.

    * Low-volume manufacturing
      
      Low-volume production deals with producing small quantity products, typically ranging from ten
      to hundreds of thousands, before the initiation of actual serial manufacturing. Implementation
      of this process offers low cost, fast production, and rapid design modification. Some crucial
      low-volume manufacturing techniques include die casting, vacuum casting, injection molding,
      sheet metal fabrication, and more.

    * Mass production
      
      Mass production, also known as continuous production, is a manufacturing process that ensures
      the production of the same standardized part for a prolonged period. This process often uses
      automation technology and assembly lines to manufacture massive amounts of similar products.
      Moreover, the end products of this technology feature high precision and excellent efficiency.

      parts and tools for the automotive, aerospace, optics, and medical industries.

# PRECISION MACHINED AIRCRAFT COMPONENTS

Mayday Manufacturing is the preferred partner in aerospace & defense, delivering high-value
precision machined components, assemblies, and metal finishing solutions with uncompromising
quality, reliability and performance.

[**Machined Products**][14]
[**Processing Services**][15]
[**Careers**][16]
[Background]

## 60+ Years Serving
## the Aviation Industry

## precision

Since 1966, Mayday Manufacturing has produced over 130,000 unique aircraft components. Our parts
have been a part of nearly every military and commercial aircraft model in the western world.
Mayday’s vertically integrated manufacturing process enables us to create parts for a wide variety
of airplane and helicopter systems.

[Precision]

## Commitment

Mayday Manufacturing is committed to consistently meeting customer requirements and exceeding
expectations. Our long history of producing high quality aircraft parts is a story of continuous
improvement driven by a love of the aerospace industry and pursuit of excellence.

[About]

## Family

Mayday is growing, but our focus on infrastructure allows us to conserve resources and continue to
provide the top-notch customer experience our clients have come to expect. We serve 850 customers in
18 countries. That reputation, built on excellence and on-time delivery, is at the core of our
expansion in the 21st century.

[Family]
[Become a Part of the Mayday Team!]

## Become a Part of the Mayday Team!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,
sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or
other legally protected status.

  ### 3D Printing
  
  ][130]
  SLA, HP MJf, SLs, and SLM are used for functional prototyping and low-volume 3D printing. Accuracy
  is +0.008 inches. Delivery timeis 1 day. Our 3D printing services can produce nearly anything,
  from custom-designed parts to patent-pending prototypes. We canalso design and modify your CAD
  files to prepare them for injection molding.
  [Learn More][131]
* [ ][132]
  [
  
  ### Sheet Metal Fabrication
  
  ][133]
  Core services include laser cutting, bending, welding, and stamping, with a dedicated sheet metal
  fabrication workshop focused onprecision manufacturing. We can process delicate parts with wall
  thicknesses as thin as 0.008 inches, with a wide range of materialthicknesses from 0.3mm to 20mm,
  adapting to diverse needs. Delivery is as fast as one day, typically three days. From easy quotes
  tofinishing options, a single supplier can produce up to 500 high-quality sheet metal parts in a
  matter of days, catering to both smalltrial runs and large-scale production runs, We guarantee
  quality throughout the entire process, ensuring consistent, reliable, anddurable sheet metal parts
  are delivered. We also offer a wide range of material options to fully support your precision
  sheet metalfabrication projects.
  [Learn More][134]
* [ ][135]
  [
  
  ### Surface Treatment
  
  ][136]
  Excellent surface treatment is crucial for enhancing our customers' brand value. We optimize our
  processing methods to achieve abalance between cost and efficiency. Our parts processing methods
  include anodizing, electroplating, polishing, and deburing. Thisnot only significantly reduces
  production costs but also effectively saves processing time, accelerating overall delivery speeds
  fromthe production end.
  [Learn More][137]
* [ ][138]
  [
  
  ### Rapid Prototyping
  
  ][139]
  Leveraging cuting-edge technology and a team of elite engineers, we deliver high-quality
  prototypes through diverse manufacturingmethods, including CNc machining, sheet metal fabrication,
  and die-casting. We offer fast turmaround services and special supportfor students and startups,
  helping accelerate design iterations and time to market.
  [Learn More][140]

Our extensive experience in high-precision parts and on-demand prototype manufacturing has earned us
the trust of numerous industry clients. These valued customers have helped us establish ourselves as
a benchmark manufacturer. We transform your ideas into reality without compromising on quality or
speed.

## Providing zero-compromise solutions for demanding precision parts

With over 30 years of experience and a fleet of over 170 German, Japanese and Swiss CNC machines, we
specialize in machining complex parts with ±0.001 mm precision. From prototype to mass production, a
99.8% yield rate and a 98% on-time delivery rate are our bottom line. You provide us with more than
just drawings; we provide you with trust. We deliver more than just parts; we guarantee a reliable
supply chain.
[  Get A Quote ][141]
[  See More Design Guidelines ][142]
Changzhou Naite Metal Technology Co., Ltd. (NAITE TECH), started in the 1990s, is located in
Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, near Shanghai, with a facility spanning 10,000 m²  and a total
investment of USD 20,000,000. The company specializes in the customization, development, and
production of high-precision metal components. Our products are widely used across various
industries, including telecommunications, home appliances, medical devices, and automotive parts,
providing advanced machining services to customers worldwide. 
 
With over 30 years of expertise, NAITE TECH has built a strong technical team covering the entire
process from design and development to casting, CNC machining, surface treatment, and assembly.
Equipped with over 170 advanced machines, including TSUGAMI, STARS, and CITIZEN sliding head lathes,
as well as inspection instruments from KEYENCE and MITUTOYO to ensure effecient production and
exceptional quality.
[ Company Story  ][143]

with a seamless one-stop service, saving you the trouble of connecting with multiple parties, making
production simpler and quality more controllable.

### Capabilities

# **CNC Machining** Beyond Competitor Capabilities

**Owens Industries — setting the standard in precision manufacturing since 1944.**

As specialists in fabricating custom metal components to meet exact tolerances, we combine
generations of experience with the industry’s best CNC machines and state-of-the-art CNC
capabilities to deliver exceptional value for U.S. companies in the aerospace, military and defense,
medical, and oil and gas industries.

## **Specialists** in Ultra-Precision Machining

Owens Industries is a leading provider of precision CNC machining services. Our services include CNC
milling (simultaneous 3, 4, and 5-axis work), wire EDM machining with .002” fine wire capable of
producing .0005” positional accuracies, CNC lathe machining, micromachining, and
deburring/finishing.

Leveraging cutting-edge technology, we ensure superior accuracy across all operations with our
programmable Swiss and German-made inspection equipment. Whether it's intricate simultaneous 5-axis
machining or complex EDM machining, our CNC machine shop delivers precise results.

### Industries

## High-Mix, Low-Volume Custom Machined Parts for **Your Industry**

As an [ISO 9001:2015 and AS 9100 certified][57] CNC machine shop, our services exceed industry
quality standards. Owens Industries specializes in nationwide ultra-precision CNC machining of small
to medium-sized parts for the highest-stakes industries in the world.

and bonus-earning opportunities. Work in a world-class, climate-controlled facility in Oak Creek,
WI.

[See Open Positions][68]

**We dig deep.** Our success and trusted industry presence stem from understanding each customer’s

regardless of where your headquarters are located. We pair extensive technical capabilities with
responsive project management and transparent communications to create a final product built to
spec, delivered on time, and within quoted budgetary parameters. That’s the Owens Industries
difference.

## Frequently asked questions
* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After
  entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a
  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.
* ### Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?
  
  Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your
  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.
* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or
  upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and
  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.
* ###  Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?
  
  Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you
  want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No
  matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that
  makes content more engaging and memorable.
* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
  [Prezi for Teams][24] is an ideal solution.
* ### What should I include in a prompt for the best AI presentation results?

## Frequently asked questions
* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After
  entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a
  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.
* ### Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?
  
  Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your
  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.
* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or
  upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and
  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.
* ###  Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?
  
  Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you
  want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No
  matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that
  makes content more engaging and memorable.
* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
  [Prezi for Teams][24] is an ideal solution.
* ### What should I include in a prompt for the best AI presentation results?
  
  For the best results, include your audience, goal, topic, tone, and any must-have points. Example:

## Nationwide Aerospace Parts Distributor

When you order our parts, you can rest assured of receiving the highest quality products backed with
full documentation of inspection data applicable to the parts. Our certification shows that we have
complied with all specifications for military socket set screws and aerospace parts. So you can
purchase in confidence when you turn to Sesco!

Founded in 1976, Sesco Industries is one of the few manufacturers still producing military-grade
socket set screws. Upon request, [we provide full certifications][13] at no additional cost,
enabling our customers to confidently bid on military contracts. We are proudly listed on the QSLM
(Qualified Suppliers List for Manufacturers) by the Defense Logistics Agency in Philadelphia,
PA—specifically approved for manufacturing screws with 3A threads.

In addition to military fasteners, we are a trusted nationwide supplier of aerospace components,
offering both standard and custom socket set screws and specialty fasteners. Contact us today to
learn more about our product offerings or to request a quote. Our team is ready to assist you with
your sourcing needs. Our aerospace parts include:

### Everything You Need to Know About Rubber Product Manufacturers in India

What varieties of rubber products do manufacturers produce?
Typically, rubber product manufacturers in India manufacture items including heavy-duty vibration
control mounts, rubber bonded to metal goods, molds, pure bump stops, and sealing goods or
components. They also create engine mounts, which are NVH parts, or custom industrial-designed
rubber goods for heavy equipment or mobilisation.
What materials are used to manufacture rubber products?
Rubber product manufacturers in India will typically use elastomers, bonded rubbers, engineered
plastics, or specialized compounds for the durability of rubber goods. They will also assess the
measurement of material strength and will seek elastomers for vibration, load, heat, and
environmental conditions.
Do rubber product manufacturers provide custom design and molding services?
Certainly, high-quality rubber product manufacturers in India manufacture custom designs and
sophisticated use of molding of rubber products, prototypes, and engineering support for complex
applications. Additionally, they will use simulation, testing, and tooling to meet customers'
expectations of performance, specifications, and durability.
How do manufacturers of rubber products ensure quality assurance?
Rubber product manufacturers in India use FMEA studies, prototype approval, and materials testing
throughout the development process. This ensures quality assurance of rubber products with
increasing customer satisfaction.

### Everything You Need to Know About Rubber Product Manufacturers in India

What varieties of rubber products do manufacturers produce?
Typically, rubber product manufacturers in India manufacture items including heavy-duty vibration
control mounts, rubber bonded to metal goods, molds, pure bump stops, and sealing goods or
components. They also create engine mounts, which are NVH parts, or custom industrial-designed
rubber goods for heavy equipment or mobilisation.
What materials are used to manufacture rubber products?
Rubber product manufacturers in India will typically use elastomers, bonded rubbers, engineered
plastics, or specialized compounds for the durability of rubber goods. They will also assess the
measurement of material strength and will seek elastomers for vibration, load, heat, and
environmental conditions.
Do rubber product manufacturers provide custom design and molding services?
Certainly, high-quality rubber product manufacturers in India manufacture custom designs and
sophisticated use of molding of rubber products, prototypes, and engineering support for complex
applications. Additionally, they will use simulation, testing, and tooling to meet customers'
expectations of performance, specifications, and durability.
How do manufacturers of rubber products ensure quality assurance?
Rubber product manufacturers in India use FMEA studies, prototype approval, and materials testing
throughout the development process. This ensures quality assurance of rubber products with
increasing customer satisfaction.
What industries use rubber products?
Prominent rubber product manufacturers in India supply their products to various industries,
including automotive, railway, defence, and construction. All of these industries heavily rely on
durable rubber mounts, seals, and bonded parts for making different equipment.
