## AS9100 Certification for Aerospace Manufacturing

Because our company serves the aerospace industry, we understand the unique requirements for quality
management that are listed under AS9100 certification. With the challenges of the aerospace industry
in mind, AS9100 sets a guideline for manufacturers of aircraft components and materials, designers
of aerospace parts and assemblies, quality management organizations working with aerospace
manufacturers, and other companies that regularly work in the aerospace industry. This certification
accounts for factors such as Counterfeit Parts Prevention and risk management, amongst many other
common aerospace concerns.

## What Is Thread Rolling and How Does It Pertain to Aerospace Manufacturing?


*We provide excellence in manufacturing high-strength, fatigue rated parts in the aerospace &
defense industry since 1952.*

The thread rolling process greatly increases a part’s fatigue life. Superior Thread Rolling
continues to research and invest in the latest threading technology, including CNC thread rolling
and inspection equipment, to guarantee we produce the highest performance threads available.

Superior Thread Rolling specializes in rolling threads after heat treatment. We routinely produce
threads on parts made of the hardest materials (up to 54 HRc) with a size range of #0 up to 6”
diameter.

Faster.

Stronger.

Better.

## Complete Manufacturing.

### Need an Aerospace or Defense manufacturing project handled from A to Z?
### We’ve got you covered:
* Material Procurement
* Supply Chain Management (100+ outside processors on our ASL)
* Engineering and Design Support
* Inventory Management (we can stock parts and ship to your schedule)
* CNC Turning/Milling
* Thread Rolling
* Centerless Grinding
* Honing
* Deburring
* Fillet Rolling
* Stress Relieving

### Technologies

Precision metal fabricators, Thin Metal Parts manufactures high-quality components to suit the
tightest specifications, utilizing [chemical milling ][21], [electroforming][22], and [laser
cutting][23] processes. An emphasis on hybrid fabrication allows us to mix techniques, providing a
broader overall product offering and better customization for our clients.  

[Contact Us][24]

# World-Class Precision Machining Quality Parts

**Trace-A-Matic** is a [precision machine shop][53] serving aerospace, automotive, defense, food
processing, forging, foundry, heavy equipment, infrastructure, marine, medical equipment, military,
mining, oil and gas, power generation, space, and transportation markets. Our state-of-the-art
manufacturing facilities offer massive capacity and utilize the latest precision machining
technology and machine tools to produce complex and intricate machined components that meet or
exceed the most critical tolerances. High-quality products machined from castings, forgings,
fabricated weldments, tubing, billets, and bar stock weighing up to 15,000 pounds.

**Trace-A-Matic has CNC machining facilities in Brookfield, WI, and Houston, TX, serving US and
international customers.**

[[Trace-A-Matic Factory Tour Video]][54]

**Trace-A-Matic Factory Tour Video**
Explore Trace-A-Matic’s new factory tour video, featuring world-class machining services,
state-of-the-art manufacturing, rigorous quality control, and climate-controlled facilities in
Brookfield, WI, and Houston, TX. Discover why Trace-A-Matic is the CNC machine shop and metal
fabricator of choice! — (2 minutes, 35 seconds)

[[Play Video]][55]

## Machining Services
* **[5-Axis CNC Machining][56]:** Complex part machining and cost savings up to 27.5” x 120”.
* **[Horizontal Milling][57]:** Single and multi-pallet machining centers up to 118” x 108” x 90”.
* **[Vertical Milling][58]:** CNC mills with right angle head capability up to 246” x 150” x 63”.
* **[Horizontal Turning][59]:** Lathe capacity up to 160” long and 35” in diameter.
* **[Vertical Turning][60]:** Live tooling capacity up to 118” in diameter and 78” tall.
* **[CNC Engineering][61]:** Expertise to help solve your toughest manufacturing challenges.
* **[CNC Fabrication][62]:** High-precision metal fabrications and mechanical assemblies.

## Machining Capability

**Trace-A-Matic** performs a full range of precision CNC machining services, from “machine complete
to print” using your materials to a Tier 1 source, managing your entire supply chain. We
successfully machine hundreds of metals, including irons, stainless steel, a wide variety of
non-ferrous metals, standard alloys, and super exotics with multi-axis CNC machines.

We develop machining programs built specifically for you and the requirements of your precision
machined parts. From raw material procurement, product CNC for manufacturability, cell program
configuration, [large part machining][63], metal fabrication, turnkey manufacturing processes, and
real-time inventory management to unmatched customer service. [Click to view our precision CNC
capabilities.][64]

## A Tradition of Precision

Trace-A-Matic was founded in 1968 on hard work, precision machining, dedication to quality, and
business integrity. We dared to take on machining challenges that other machine shops wouldn’t or

processing, forging, foundry, heavy equipment, infrastructure, marine, medical equipment, military,

manufacturing facilities offer massive capacity and utilize the latest precision machining

## Work Process

01

### Analysis of Client Needs & Goals

We start by deeply understanding your project requirements—from part design details to production
volumes. Our team aligns on tolerances, materials, and timelines to ensure full clarity before
moving forward.
02

### Tailored Manufacturing Solution Design

Leveraging CNC, 3D printing, and sheet metal expertise, we craft a customized plan. This includes
process selection, cost - effective strategies, and quality control checkpoints to match your exact
needs.
03

### End-to-End Production & Delivery

From prototyping to mass production, we execute with tech - driven precision. Real - time updates,
strict quality audits, and on - time delivery ensure your parts meet standards and reach you
seamlessly & securely.

## 100+ Materials Can Be Freely Selected

By understanding its unique characteristics, select the ideal materials to ensure project success.
We can also meet your requirements for uncommon materials or specific material grades.

## [Aluminum][79]

Lightweight, corrosion-resistant, highly conductive, versatile in applications.

## [Brass][80]

Dense, malleable, low friction, excellent acoustic properties.

## [Stainless Steel][81]

Rust-resistant, strong, hygienic, widely used in industry.

## [Steel][82]

Tough, high tensile strength, foundational in construction.

## [Copper][83]

Exceptionally conductive, malleable, antimicrobial, aesthetically appealing.

## [Titanium][84]

Superior strength-to-weight ratio, biocompatible, corrosion-resistant.

## [Cast Iron][85]

## NAIA

NAIA Global Inc. traces its origins to the North American Importers Association (NAIA), an
organization founded in Washington, D.C. in 1987. With a longstanding history and an extensive
global network, NAIA has supported international trade by providing vital resources in sourcing,
procurement, and business development to over 137,000 importer members across five continents.

Building on this foundation, NAIA Global Inc. was established as a professional and independent
entity in Taiwan. Evolving from NAIA’s original Asia-Pacific operations, the company is committed to
bridging the strength of Asian manufacturing with the demands of global markets. Our mission is to
foster meaningful, long-term partnerships between Asian suppliers and international buyers.

With a seasoned consulting team and decades of practical experience, NAIA Global Inc. offers
tailored solutions across more than 300 industries, including hardware, machinery, plastics,
electronics, food, and building materials.

NAIA Global delivers far more than a traditional matchmaking platform—it is a strategic partner that
empowers Asian manufacturers to expand their global reach and realize their full potential on the
international stage. Through our international reach and local expertise, we aim to make every
collaboration a stepping stone toward lasting value.

## NAIA

NAIA Global Inc. traces its origins to the North American Importers Association (NAIA), an
organization founded in Washington, D.C. in 1987. With a longstanding history and an extensive
global network, NAIA has supported international trade by providing vital resources in sourcing,
procurement, and business development to over 137,000 importer members across five continents.

Building on this foundation, NAIA Global Inc. was established as a professional and independent
entity in Taiwan. Evolving from NAIA’s original Asia-Pacific operations, the company is committed to
bridging the strength of Asian manufacturing with the demands of global markets. Our mission is to
foster meaningful, long-term partnerships between Asian suppliers and international buyers.

With a seasoned consulting team and decades of practical experience, NAIA Global Inc. offers
tailored solutions across more than 300 industries, including hardware, machinery, plastics,
electronics, food, and building materials.

NAIA Global delivers far more than a traditional matchmaking platform—it is a strategic partner that
empowers Asian manufacturers to expand their global reach and realize their full potential on the
international stage. Through our international reach and local expertise, we aim to make every
collaboration a stepping stone toward lasting value.

## Strategic Partner

Member Importer Benefits
* Auto-matching with compatible, pre-qualified member suppliers.
* Assist in further sourcing if none is available.
* Co-ordinate & liaise in sampling & execution of orders.
* Act as mediator during unavoidable commercial disputes.
* Credit verification of member suppliers.
* Travel arrangement.
